english.title: False statement in response to information notice re registerable beneficial owner
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in purported compliance with an information notice issued under

(A)_[section 12]_
(B)_[section 13]_

of the Economic Crime (Transparency and Enforcement) Act 2022 made a statement knowing that it was false or, recklessly made a statement that was false in a material particular
english.legislation: Contrary to section 15(2) and (5) of the Economic Crime (Transparency and Enforcement) Act 2022.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: This offence document should not be used after the 3rd March 2024 as it was repealed by the Economic Crime and Corporate Transparency Act 2023. For offences applying from the 4th March 2024, see H101610 (basic) and H101611 (aggravated).

other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and / or a fineIndictment: maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or fine

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

Note
The maximum penalty on summary conviction increased from 2nd May 2022. This applies only to offences committed on or after that date. For offences committed before 2nd May 2022 the maximum penalty on summary conviction is six months.
